items.title: CVS Health Raised Its 2026 Outlook 3 Times, but Not Its Dividend
items.summary: CVS has the cash, the earnings momentum, and a recovering Aetna, yet shareholders have collected the same payout for 12 straight quarters. Management has other priorities first, and a planned breakup could complicate the answer.

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Plans Two Company Breakup
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) plans to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies focused on healthcare services and retail pharmacy. The board has approved the breakup plan, with management outlining a multiyear transition to complete the separation. CVS Health released new study findings on GLP 1 medicines that highlight clinical benefits alongside significant affordability and access challenges. There is more to CVS Health than the planned breakup and fresh GLP 1 research findings...

items.title: UnitedHealth Sinks 5% on Medicare Advantage Audit Plan as CMS Moves to “Crush” Medical Fraud
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 5% after CMS proposed clawing back Medicare Advantage overpayments as far back as payment year 2018, and Humana and CVS Health fell too. CMS estimates the audits would recover about $9 billion per payment year industry-wide, and UnitedHealth hasn’t sized its share.
